clause_count_general_terms._verification: CONFIRMED at 80 by independent scripted enumeration of clause headings across pages 7-61, cross-checked by manual grep for each number. The sequence 1..80 is gapless with no duplicates and nothing above 80. Six clauses (19, 44, 45, 56, 57, 67) have titles long enough to wrap into the body column and are missed by a naive 'number + title + 2-space gap' pattern — they are genuine clauses, verified individually. This resolves the 79-vs-80 question in analisis_pipeline_kontrak.md A.4 in favour of 80; the original 79 came from a coordinate spot-check (x0<110) that dropped one of the wrapped-title clauses.

sub_document_count._scope_caveat: This is a PROFILE-RELATIVE invariant, not a statement about the document's content. perpres16_konstruksi_v1 declares exactly 5 sub_document_markers, so 5 is the maximum detectable under that profile.

sub_document_count._recommendation: The document contains 8 logically distinct sub-documents. SPPBJ and SPMK carry extractable metadata (numbers, rate, duration) and are currently absorbed into main_agreement, which means chunk-level provenance for those values is wrong. Consider adding markers for them and revising this invariant to 7-8. Recorded as 5 here so the file matches the profile as it currently ships — do not treat 5 as validation that the profile is complete.

_identifier_survival_note: Each string above must appear byte-identical in the raw/exact-search layer after extraction.
